title: A ring or arc gets a full turn, forever, when Rotation is added
goal: In the spinner walkthrough, adding Rotation to a ring or arc arrives as 0 to 360 degrees with Repeat on Forever, because that is what a spinner is. Today every shape arrives as a small swing back and forth, so a person has to retype both ends and the repeat before anything spins.
notes: Mock docs/design/mocks/pages/icon-loop-wt.html step 3 #motNote: Rotation arrives at 0 to 360 with Repeat on Forever when the shape is a ring. Code: LayerMotion.starting(.rotation, on:) in Sources/PhotonzCore/LayerMotion.swift ~1206, currently -12..12 foreverThereAndBack for every layer. Found by a-spinner-can-turn-about-the-middle-of-the-artbo.
acceptance: Adding Rotation to an ellipse or an open arc path in an icon frame arrives as From 0, To 360, Repeat Forever, at Next defaults
Other shapes keep the swing they arrive with today
A walk adds Rotation to an arc and reads 0, 360 and Forever on the row
